evals.name: optimize-named-model-default-turns
evals.expected_output: Agent runs 3 outer-loop campaigns for lightgbm, each with a unique experiment_id manifest, reads results between turns, reasons about hyperparameter patterns, and gives a cross-campaign summary with best config + test honesty check. Never touches ETL files.

evals.name: tune-with-turn-override
evals.expected_output: Agent runs exactly 2 outer-loop campaigns for random_forest (not 3), each with a unique experiment_id, and summarizes across both. Recognizes random_forest has fewer tunable knobs than lightgbm (no num_leaves/learning_rate) and reasons accordingly.

evals.name: missing-model-name-asks
evals.prompt: find better hyperparameters for the model
evals.expected_output: Agent does NOT guess a model. It asks the user to name the model (lightgbm, random_forest, etc.) before proceeding, since the model name is required and selects the trainer.
